acceptanceCriteria: Every requested requirement has an expected outcome and a retained actual result.
Two synthetic tenants cannot read or mutate each other’s records through direct backend requests.
Login, logout, expiry, recovery and role-denial cases pass in the isolated environment.
Payment test mode, webhook validation, idempotency and duplicate-delivery cases pass; no live charge was made.
Responsive/keyboard flows, error states, build tests and security findings are reviewed.
Deployment approval is separate from execution and post-deploy verification.
limitations: These are proposed agent definitions, not created users, deployed agents or executable workflows.
Export downloads a design file only; it does not save a workspace version or create server-side agents.
Connector requirements are not a provider catalogue, connection inventory or proof of an official MCP integration.
No code was generated, run, deployed, researched or independently verified by this architect.
